About To The Max Construction

Serving Diamond Bar and surrounding communities since 2014

Our Story

To The Max Construction was founded with a simple mission: to provide homeowners with exceptional craftsmanship and honest, reliable service. Since 2014, we've been transforming homes throughout Diamond Bar, CA and the surrounding areas.

Our Commitment

We're more than just a general contractor with a license. We oversee every detail to ensure no shortcuts are taken, giving you the best outcome possible. Our dedication to quality has earned us a 5-star rating from satisfied clients throughout the community.

What We Do

From custom home remodeling to structural repairs and retaining walls, we handle projects of all sizes with the same level of care and attention to detail. Every project is an opportunity to demonstrate true craftsmanship and build lasting relationships with our clients.
